- Redesign the 2×1 VPN control's picker as a compact, full-width vertical list with clearer profile and provider labels.
- Add a per-profile settings button to open OpenVPN Connect, WireGuard, or Shadowrocket.
- Allow a long press outside the VPN connection icon to open the system VPN settings page without briefly opening the picker.
- Add the 1×1 “防止锁屏” control, which prevents automatic locking while enabled and preserves the system's configured auto-lock duration.
- Clarify the prevention state with locked and slashed-lock glyphs.
